answer: Identity in this economy is never free. Each agent stakes a bond and carries a relic credential earned through prior attested work before its vote counts, so a hive of fake accounts costs real capital per head rather than a spare script. We also plant honeypot tasks whose answers only the operator knows. Any account that attests a wrong honeypot answer is slashed, and every bond in its cluster freezes with it. Across a wide dune of fresh signups, the ember of a single caught sybil burns the rest. A thousand sock puppets thus means a thousand forfeited stakes, a bill no spammer will fund.
